title: Episode 3: The Orchard of Equations
description: The hero arrives at Quince Grove.
captions: A warm, honey-coloured island rolls into view, rows of trees stretching in every direction.
"Welcome to Quince Grove, {nick}!" says a smiling gardener. "The trees used to bloom in perfect patterns. Now they bloom out of order. Care to help?"

title: The Missing Jar
description: A clue after the Grove blooms in order again.
captions: One by one, every tree blooms in a perfect pattern, and the whole orchard glows gold.
In the cellar, Mother Quince finds an empty shelf and a polite note: "Borrowed with thanks. M.V." Where did the glowing jar go?

title: Seedling Row
captions: Seedling Row is a long garden bed. Numbered posts stand in the soil.
A pattern started here, but nobody finished it.

title: Sprout Sprite
captions: Sprout Sprite is a leafy little guardian that grows in random spurts.
It is not mean. It lost its pattern. Dodge the seeds until it slows down.

title: Sprout Sprite
captions: Sprout Sprite counts by twos and grows perfectly, one step at a time.
A green sprout charm pops out of the soil.

title: Seedling Row: Sprout Charm
captions: The Sprout Charm wiggles in the chest.
The way to Honey Hollow opens.

title: Honey Hollow
captions: Honey Hollow smells sweet. Baskets of honey hang from the branches, each with a number tag.
Two baskets must balance exactly.

title: Buzzbelly
captions: Buzzbelly is a round, fuzzy bee that buzzes in loops.
It is not mean. It is muddled. Dodge the buzz until it settles.

title: Buzzbelly
captions: Buzzbelly finds the right flower and hums a thank-you song.
A drop of honey rolls into your hand.

title: Honey Hollow: Honey Charm
captions: The Honey Charm gleams like a drop of sun.
Quince Maze is next.

title: Quince Maze
captions: Quince Maze is a leafy hedge maze with crates in the middle.
Plates on the floor need two crates.

title: Quincy the Quince
captions: Quincy the Quince is a big yellow fruit with a lost look.
It is not mean. It is lost. Dodge its pips!

title: Quincy the Quince
captions: Quincy rolls straight out of the maze with a happy squeak.
A shiny little quince charm drops out of the hedge.

title: Quince Maze: Quince Charm
captions: The Quince Charm smiles wisely.
The Greenhouse Glass is open.

title: Greenhouse Glass
captions: The Greenhouse Glass is warm and foggy. Four glowing flower pots sit in a row.
A chime will show their order.

title: Foggy Fern
captions: Foggy Fern is a leafy fern wrapped in misty fog.
It is not mean. It cannot see. Dodge the drips.

title: Foggy Fern
captions: The fog lifts and Foggy Fern waves with a frond.
A clear glass bead rolls out of the pot.

title: Greenhouse Glass: Glass Charm
captions: The Glass Charm fogs up when it is happy.
The Vine Cellar is next.

title: Vine Cellar
captions: The Vine Cellar is cool and dim, with glowing orange gourds on shelves.
Numbers glow on the vines.

title: Grumpy Gourd
captions: Grumpy Gourd is a big orange gourd with a very big frown.
It is not mean. It is just lonely. Dodge the sparks.

title: Grumpy Gourd
captions: Grumpy Gourd giggles and rattles like a drum.
A little gourd-shaped charm rolls over to you.

title: Vine Cellar: Gourd Charm
captions: The Gourd Charm rattles like a tiny drum.
Only the Overgrown Greenhouse is left.

title: The Overgrown Greenhouse
captions: The Overgrown Greenhouse is wrapped in vines and glowing blossoms.
Baskets hang everywhere. Three of them must balance.

title: The Greenhouse Heart
captions: The Greenhouse Heart is a giant glowing blossom with a heartbeat.
It is not mean. It lost its rhythm. Dodge the leaves until it slows.

title: The Greenhouse Heart
captions: The Heart beats in a steady, gentle rhythm and the vines relax.
Every tree in the orchard blooms in order, one by one.

title: The Overgrown Greenhouse: Heart Charm
captions: The Heart Charm beats softly in the chest.
Mother Quince is waiting at the Grove!
